description: Ratchet eval fixture: footnotes as a ratchet step (issue #83). `notes` grows one key at a time through a paired write: the server picks the item whose `note` is empty and the key slug, the model writes only the note text, copied verbatim from a source. `extras` items may carry a `note`, which must already be a key in `notes`.

note.role: key into `notes`; renders a [^key] footnote ref
key into `notes`; must match a `notes` key exactly

notes.role: footnotes: key -> note text, rendered as [^key]: definitions. The server picks the key and the item it attaches to; write the note text only, copied verbatim from a source
